name: Greasepaint Mime
flavor: White face, black tears, both palms pressed flat against nothing at all — and the nothing holds.

features.name: The Wall
features.description: As an action it presses its hands against the air and a wall that is not there becomes real: a 10-foot line, 10 feet high, in unoccupied squares within 15 feet. Nothing crosses it. A creature may spend an action to break it with a DC 12 Strength check, and it collapses on its own when the Mime drops.

tactics: It splits the party and then picks on whichever half is smaller. The wall goes up on the first turn, not the last — a Mime that waits has misunderstood the act.
narration: Its hands stop dead in the air an inch from each other, and the sound of everything on the far side of them stops with them.
